repos_data.description: Library for conversion between Traditional and Simplified Chinese

Free, open-source CleanMyMac alternative for macOS. Native SwiftUI disk cleaner for app caches, node_modules, Xcode DerivedData, Docker and AI tool caches (Codex, Claude Code, Ollama) - nothing is ever really deleted: it all goes to the Trash and stays undoable. No telemetry, no subscription.
